mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (user1_type, user1_id, user2_type, user2_id, create_time) VALUES (#{user1Type}, #{user1Id}, #{user2Type}, #{user2Id}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM conversation WHERE (user1_type = #{userType} AND user1_id = #{userId}) OR (user2_type = #{userType} AND user2_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY last_message_time DESC
